global_summary: A CBS Atlanta news report covers a train collision with a red car at a railroad crossing in Douglasville, Georgia. The video includes aerial footage showing the severely crushed vehicle wedged under the freight train, emergency responders and police managing the scene, and a tow truck beginning recovery operations. Reporter Steve Kiggins provides live on-site coverage at night, with additional segments featuring interviews with local residents, maps pinpointing the location at E Broad St and Mozley St, and footage of railroad workers assessing the damage. The report also shows related safety concerns at Atlanta railroad crossings, including malfunctioning traffic signals and everyday traffic navigating the intersections.
